title: Knots with no cycle, and growth among the newest four
claim: Under NAE: T1 every finite pattern of three-place knots with no cycle of knots (Berge-acyclic) allows a state, has no tie, has hollow triples exactly its knots (read faithfully), and the least bond containing two distinctions d steps apart has exactly d + 2 distinctions (the alternating chain), none for different components; T2 every pattern whose knots each lie within four consecutive distinctions of an integer interval allows a state, and from a least element every state of an initial segment extends; T3 the ten knots on five distinctions allow no state; T4 a knot with a distinction in no other knot never makes a contradiction (O global (0) and T never end), newest-four growth never ends, newest-w growth with w >= 5 and closing probability q > 0 ends with probability one with a geometric tail; C1 the last base ties the killing knot's three distinctions equal (by definition).
failure_conditions: A Berge-acyclic pattern with a tie, an unnamed hollow triple, or a pair whose least bond is not steps + 2.
A pattern with every knot within four consecutive distinctions that allows no state.
A 2-colouring of five distinctions with no monochromatic triple.
remaining_obligations: Referee pass on T1 to T4.
foundation_claim_scope: Finite patterns of three-place knots under NAE (T1, T3, T4); T2 also for patterns indexed by the natural numbers or the integers, with no source label claimed for infinite patterns.

validation.novelty: known in substance (Berge-acyclic 2-colourability, greedy colouring, pigeonhole); the least-bond statement of T1 and the alternating chain not found stated (bounded search); T4 applies them to processes defined in this epic.
